description: The organizer's own overview of their event, read only. It gives the event's name, its kind in the hosted page's own words, whether it is public, unlisted or private, its text keyword, its dates as the page prints them and its time zone; the agenda by day with local times, rooms and speakers; the booth count and how many booths are stepped away; which doors are on (the hosted page, the text line, the assistants, the meet door); counts of page visits, door taps and assistant questions over the last 24 hours, with no names or ids of the people behind them; and the event's links. Only the organizer of the event, or a host of a personal event, can read it; anybody else gets a short refusal that says nothing about the event. It needs a personal connector token and changes nothing. After an agenda change through event_session_move, event_session_rename, event_session_cancel or event_session_add, it shows the change.

eventIdOrName.description: The event id or the event name as the organizer spells it.
